fit_reason: Whole vintage aluminum runabout with outboard and trailer, listed under boats by owner.
findings: Faded, chalky red paint along the starboard hull side
Light grey primer-looking patch on the starboard red panel (touch-up candidate)
Dull, weathered paint and scuffs on the port hull and bow
Dirty, discolored white vinyl bimini top and side curtains
Dusty, scuffed cream vinyl seats with grime in the seams
Dusty red carpet on the cockpit floor
Grime and clutter (spare tires, loose items) in the rear cockpit by the transom
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the AlumaCraft Tampico II. The red paint on the hull sides looks a bit faded and the cream seats and top could use a cleaning, and a buff and detail would really help those vintage lines show in photos. We do pre-sale details for boats and come to you. Would you like a quote?
